text:
Rina - PMM: Dropping the trimmed launch blog draft in drive. Hoping for a 24h quick-pass: content polish, design hero, legal on headline claim, and confirm the webinar CTA + RSVP flow.
Oliver - Content: Link: https://drive.google.com/redwood-launch-draft-2026 (please comment inline). Draft focuses on: problem (serving unpredictability), our approach (smart routing + caching), a small benchmark, and clear webinar CTA.
Nora - Design: Can we make the hero visual show an apples-to-apples cost-per-token comparison and a tiny latency sparkline? Vector preferred for slide reuse. I can mock by EOB today if someone confirms the CSV.
Diego - Growth: Webinar slots: Mon 4pm PT or Thu 10am PT preferred. Mon hits APAC decently; Thu better for EMEA. I can seed calendar once we pick. Also propose UTMs: utm_source=rw_blog&utm_medium=article&utm_campaign=dedicated_launch_q2&utm_term=launch_cta.
Rina - PMM: Good. Oliver please add a one-line bench note under the figure describing test harness and seed any internal perf doc link. Priya will need that for the claim language.
Oliver - Content: Bench caption added: "Test harness: open-model-8B baseline, 64-token eval batches, no KV cache. Redwood run: quant-8, smart-batching enabled, cache priming on." Internal run: https://internal/redwood/perf/launch-q2-2026
Priya - Legal: Headline "reduces inference spend substantially" is safe. Avoid absolute % without method note. If you want a number, use: "reduced per-token spend by as much as 60% in our internal tests" and link to the perf doc. Also label any customer quote as "beta customer" unless an approved quote exists.
Rina - PMM: Ok change headline to: "In our internal tests, Redwood reduced per-token inference spend by as much as 60% vs baseline." Oliver pls update.
Oliver - Content: Updated. Also I pasted a short publish checklist here:
- SEO title: Redwood Dedicated: Predictable Inference & Cost Controls
- Meta desc (155 chars): Ship LLM features with predictable latency and lower inference spend. Join our launch webinar to learn more.
- Hero alt text: chart comparing per-token spend vs baseline
- Bench footnote link: https://internal/redwood/perf/launch-q2-2026
- Webinar CTA link: https://redwood.com/events/launch-q2
- HubSpot form id: hs_launch_q2_02
- Author byline: Rina K. (with Oliver)
Nora - Design: Requested CSV for plot: https://drive.google.com/redwood-perf-csv-q2 (Oliver confirmed). I'll drop two hero variants in #design-review by 5pm. Keeping brand greens + deep slate.
Sam - Ops: I created provisional HubSpot form hs_launch_q2_02 and added hidden fields for UTMs. Workflow routing: if interest_area == "dedicated" -> assign to Team_Dedicated; else assign to inbound_queue. Will finalize after Diego confirms field names.
Diego - Growth: Field mapping for HubSpot: utm_source->hs_utm_source, utm_medium->hs_utm_medium, utm_campaign->hs_utm_campaign, utm_term->hs_utm_term. I'll share the calendar invite language after slot locked.
calendar-bot: Calendar event created (provisional): "Redwood Launch Webinar  Mon 2026-04-06 16:00 PT". Zoom: https://zoom.example/redwood-launch-q2. RSVP link: https://redwood.com/rsvp/launch-q2
Priya - Legal: Also flagging trademark language: don't call competitor names out in the copy. Fine to use generic comparisons ("baseline model").
Rina - PMM: Plan for today: Oliver finalizes copy with updated headline and bench footnote, Nora uploads hero options, Priya quick-sign by 3pm, Diego locks calendar slot and UTMs, Sam wires HubSpot hidden fields and routing. If anyone misses the 3pm check, ping me.
Oliver - Content: Will also run a short SEO sweep and paste final publish checklist back here once complete.
Nora - Design: Uploading mock A & B to #design-review now.
Diego - Growth: Once signoff done, I'll create the social snippets and short registration ad copy for paid channels.
Rina - PMM: Thanks everyone. Quick and tidy. :tada:
